{{Quote|What CorSec has never figured out, and what I know well, is that these Meatlumps would never break, never lie down, never bend over for anybody. Anybody.|The [[Meatlump King]], to spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|The Meatlump King|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Meatlumps''', also known as the '''Meatlump Gang''', were a band of fanatical technology-hating ruffians, criminals, and terrorists active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Our king says that electronics are the source of evil in the world and must be purged. Only simple machines and combustion engines are acceptable.|[[Ubbal Fenn]], to spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: Assault and Battery|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The Meatlumps were originally known as a group of anti-technology thugs and small-time criminals from the planet Corellia.<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" /> They were described by the [[Corellian Security Force]] authorities as "fanatical" and "somewhat stupid" progress haters.<ref name="CDHZ" /> Most of the Meatlumps spent their time in destroying technological devices. They did not directly attack people but, due to their fanatical destructive nature, they could be very dangerous. In fact their indirect victims numbered in the thousands<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" /> Furthermore, some Meatlumps had turned to terrorists and did not hesitate in planting bombs in densely populated cities to achieve their objectives.<ref name="SWG:MtM2" />

[[File:Meatlump-AoD.png|thumb|left|200px|A Meatlump.]]
The Meatlumps were based predominantly on Corellia where they had made themselves a home in abandoned [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels|maintenance tunnels]] beneath the city of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]]. It was in this secret [[Meatlump Hideout|hideout]] that the [[Meatlump King]] lived and held court to his followers.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> Since the Meatlumps despised technology, most of them refused space travel.<ref name="SWG:TMHP3">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 3|Corellia}}</ref> However, they had managed to establish a small presence on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:MtM2" />

Virtually all members of the Meatlump Gang were [[Human/Legends|Human]]. They usually wore red-colored clothes and had their hairs dyed in bright colors.<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" /> Meatlump ranks included dunder, lunk, donk, simp, nerp, [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and decider.<ref name="SWG:MR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Meatlump Rank}}</ref> The gang had even adopted its own [[Currency/Legends|currency]] known as the [[Meatlump Lump]].<ref name="Meatlumps" />

The Meatlumps were in open conflict with the Corellian Security Force as well with the [[Rogue CorSec]]s and [[Beldonna's League]].<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref> Also, the Meatlumps and the [[Ragtags|Ragtag gang]] were known to have a very hostile relationship. The Ragtags really hated the Meatlumps for some reason, even though the Meatlumps barely acknowledged the Ragtags existed.<ref name="SWG:CSV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Starport Vandalism|Corellia}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I was the first. When I started, I was the only one. Though back then, the name meatlump only referred to a delicious snack. It was Draykken who named us Meatlumps! But even so, it is only right that I am King. For I am the tallest and the most glorious.|The Meatlump King, to spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMK" />}}
[[File:MeatKing.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Meatlump King]].]]
The Meatlumps were formed by an ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who regretted that he had helped build weapons for the Empire. When Imperial assassins attempted to kill him, his three sons, described by the CorSec authorities as "dullards in their own right" helped the [[Meatlump King]] to create the Meatlumps, naming the gang after their [[Meatlump (food)|favorite food]].<ref name="CDHZ" /> These three brothers &mdash; [[Hraykken Bender|Hraykken]], [[Draykken Bender|Draykken]] and [[Louis Bender]] &mdash; were in fact taken by the King from their abusive biological father, the mad scientist [[Lucien Bender]].<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bountied!|Corellia}}</ref> While the Meatlump King became the ideological and public leader of the Meatlumps, the Bender brothers handled the daily operational details of the gang activities.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> In response, their father Lucien created the [[Bofa Treat Gang]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> also named after [[Bofa treat|food]],<ref name="SWG" /> and placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his three sons.<ref name="SWG:B" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the conflict with the Ragtags continued to escalate. The Ragtags once vandalized the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]], hoping to blame the Meatlumps and get them into trouble.<ref name="SWG:CSV" /> Furthermore, the violent attacks from a group of Ragtags led by [[Gramo Murah]] forced the band of Meatlumps led by [[Strilath Farles]] to flee Corellia and [[Meatlump Camps|relocate]] on the planet Talus.<ref name="SWG:TMHP4">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 4|Corellia}}</ref>

A group of Meatlumps, including [[Ubbal Fenn]],<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> [[Pech Seki]]<ref name="SWG:MQ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meatlump Quitting|Corellia}}</ref> and [[Hrath Koo]],<ref name="SWG:HKMD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Hrath Koo Must Die|Corellia}}</ref> was based in a [[Meatlump Cave|cave]] near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> they attacked the starship [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Osto Grissom]] because he used to transport electronics<ref name="SWG:CCFAaB" /> and harassed [[Teilo Monnro]]'s shop in Tyrena.<ref name="SWG:HKMD" />

[[File:MeatLumpsGraffiti.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A graffiti created by the Meatlumps.]]
After the Battle of Yavin, the activities of the Meatlumps were investigated by the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' journalist [[Vani Korr]] who, with the help of an unknown traveler.<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" /> Around 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Vani Korr published an article called ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]''. In the article she revealed that while displaying the behavior of mere thugs, the Meatlumps had actually never directly caused the death of anyone. She suggested that they actually viewed people as obstacles rather than targets, and once out of the way, they were ignored. Instead, the Meatlumps seemed to focus on technological devices, and that whenever they did attack anyone, it was usually to acquire one such device. Korr had herself been attacked by the Meatlumps, but as soon as she was no longer an obstacle for them, they ignored her and focused on her [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. She concluded that they were dangerous, and could reveal that they were led by the three Bender brothers.<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" /> Vani Korr and the spacer later continued to investigate the Meatlumps as they wished to determine whether the Meatlump King truly existed. The reporter started tracking crimes of vandalism against machinery and technology in order to find some Meatlumps. She finally received word that a Meatlump was smashing generators in Coronet. This old Meatlump, [[Alliin Mepou]], was quite disillusioned but he could not retire from the Meatlumps unless a new person take his place. The spacer, who realized he could use this situation to infiltrate the Meatlumps, indeed accepted to replace the old man. The spacer therefore went to work for Alliin Mepou's lieutenant, [[Kaiya Merel]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP5">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 5|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer performed several missions for the lieutenant, including killing one of her rivals, another Meatlump lieutenant by the name [[Stephax Dain]], and attacking a [[Weapons Research Facility (Rori)|Weapons Research Facility]] on Rori.<ref name="SWG:TMHP7">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 7|Corellia}}</ref> Kaiya Merel therefore accepted the spacer among the Meatlumps and gave to her new recruit full access to the secret Meatlump Hideout.<ref name="SWG:MHYFT" /> The spacer was one of the few non-Meatlumps who entered the Meatlump Hideout and finally encountered the fabled Meatlump King. The information gathered in the hideout allowed Vani Korr to finalize her article. She revealed the presence of the Meatlump Hideout below the streets of Coronet and the existence of the Meatlump King.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

[[File:AssaultandBattery.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Meatlump King is apprehended by a CorSec agent.]]
Meanwhile, another ''Corellia Times'' reporter, [[Halden Wes]], joined the investigation and inquired about the Meatlump terrorist activities, particularly outside their home planet. In fact, the Meatlumps had established camp near the cities of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] and [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on Corellia, [[Nashal]] on Talus, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on Naboo, [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on Rori, [[Nym's Stronghold]] on Lok, and near [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] and [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] on Tatooine where they gathered large amounts of supplies, food, weapons and explosives. They also placed bombs in several of these cities. As it appeared that the Meatlumps were planning terrorist attacks, Halden Wes hired a spacer to raid the Meatlump camps. The spacer traveled to all those worlds and sacked the camps.<ref name="SWG:MtM2" />

Later the same year, Hraykken and Draykken Bender sent a spacer affiliated with the Meatlumps attack a [[Helper droid factory|droid factory]] that manufactured helper [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:RAL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Revenge At Last!|Corellia}}</ref> A short time later, Louis Bender was captured by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. The spacer rescued Louis and killed his biological father, Lucien Bender, in the process.<ref name="SWG:B" />

At some point, a Corellian Security Force agent entered the hideout and apprehended the Meatlump King at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]] in his throne room.<ref name="TotC">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Assault and Battery}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Meatlumps appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The background story of the Meatlumps was revealed with Vani Korr's quest line "[[:w:c:swg:Corellian Times Investigations|Corellian Times Investigations]],"<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" /> added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," released on [[August 4]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> This story was later widely expanded with the introduction of the so-called "[[:w:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]" with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
